nodes.label: AI Integration Architecture (Trstprep Admin Panel)
nodes.rationale: Root architecture specification document for AI capabilities in the Trstprep admin panel, leveraging OpenRouter API.

nodes.label: AI-Powered Question Generation (P0)
nodes.rationale: Highest priority feature; generates MCQ/true-false/short-answer questions from topic, difficulty, type, and count parameters via OpenRouter.

nodes.label: Intelligent Content Tagging (P1)
nodes.rationale: Suggests 5-8 relevant tags for content using gpt-3.5-turbo to support Questions, Tests, and Study Materials managers.

nodes.label: Semantic Search (P1)
nodes.rationale: Embeds queries and content via text-embedding-ada-002, stores in pgvector columns, performs cosine similarity search across questions/tests/study_materials.

nodes.label: Predictive Analytics Dashboard (P2)
nodes.rationale: Forecasts churn, calibrates difficulty, predicts revenue and engagement using time-series heuristics on test_attempts data.

nodes.label: Automated Content Quality Scoring (P2)
nodes.rationale: Evaluates clarity, accuracy, difficulty, answer correctness, and explanation quality on a 0-100 scale via gpt-4.

nodes.label: Smart FAQ Generation (P2)
nodes.rationale: Analyzes support tickets and existing FAQs to auto-generate new FAQ entries via gpt-3.5-turbo.

nodes.label: Adaptive Learning Path Generation (P3)
nodes.rationale: Creates personalized study plans with dynamic difficulty adjustment and prerequisite recommendations.

nodes.label: Voice-to-Question Conversion (P3)
nodes.rationale: Transcribes audio via whisper-1, then converts transcript into a structured MCQ question via gpt-3.5-turbo.

nodes.label: Automated Content Moderation (P3)
nodes.rationale: Detects inappropriate content, validates answer correctness, checks for plagiarism, and flags biased language.

nodes.label: admin-ai.js Backend Router
nodes.rationale: Node.js Express router consolidating all AI endpoints (generate-questions, suggest-tags, embed, search, predict-churn, quality-score, generate-faq, transcribe-audio).

nodes.label: QuestionsManager.jsx (Frontend)
nodes.rationale: React component integrating AI Generation modal; primary integration point for question generation and content tagging UI.

nodes.label: AIGenerationModal React Component
nodes.rationale: Modal collecting topic, difficulty, questionType, count, context; calls /api/admin/ai/generate-questions and forwards generated questions to parent.

nodes.label: embedding-worker.js (Background Worker)
nodes.rationale: Hourly scheduled worker that backfills embeddings for questions, tests, and study_materials using text-embedding-ada-002.

nodes.label: aiRateLimiter.js Middleware
nodes.rationale: express-rate-limit configuration: 50 requests/hour keyed by user id (or IP fallback) for AI routes.

nodes.label: AIMonitoringDashboard.jsx
nodes.rationale: Dashboard surfacing API calls, tokens, monthly cost, daily usage chart, and per-feature cost breakdown.

nodes.label: AdminLayout.jsx (Search Bar)
nodes.rationale: Hosts the global search bar (lines 353-406) that wires user queries into the semantic search endpoint.

nodes.label: TestsManager.jsx
nodes.rationale: Frontend manager consuming AI tagging and quality scoring services for test entities.

nodes.label: StudyMaterialsManager.jsx
nodes.rationale: Frontend manager that integrates AI tagging for study material entities.

nodes.label: FaqManager.jsx
nodes.rationale: Frontend manager that consumes Smart FAQ Generation AI endpoint.

nodes.label: SubjectRelationsManager.jsx
nodes.rationale: Integration point for adaptive learning path generation, modeling subject prerequisites.

nodes.label: CurriculumBuilder.jsx
nodes.rationale: Integration point for adaptive learning paths; constructs AI-generated curricula.

nodes.label: DeepAnalytics.jsx
nodes.rationale: Analytics dashboard consuming predictive analytics features (churn, difficulty, revenue).

nodes.label: AdminAnalytics.jsx
nodes.rationale: High-level analytics dashboard integrating predictive features surfaced by DeepAnalytics.

nodes.label: OpenRouter API
nodes.rationale: External unified LLM gateway at https://openrouter.ai/api/v1; OpenAI SDK used with custom baseURL to access multiple model providers.

nodes.label: openai/gpt-4
nodes.rationale: Primary model for question generation and content quality scoring; $0.01/1K input, $0.03/1K output.

nodes.label: openai/gpt-3.5-turbo
nodes.rationale: Lower-cost model for content tagging, FAQ generation, and voice-to-question conversion; $0.001/1K input, $0.002/1K output.

nodes.label: anthropic/claude-3-sonnet
nodes.rationale: Alternative provider model specified for question generation; $0.003/1K input, $0.015/1K output.

nodes.label: openai/text-embedding-ada-002
nodes.rationale: 1536-dim embedding model used for semantic search; $0.0001/1K tokens.

nodes.label: openai/whisper-1
nodes.rationale: Speech-to-text model used to transcribe audio before question conversion.

nodes.label: ai_api_usage Table
nodes.rationale: PostgreSQL audit/cost table tracking user_id, model, endpoint, input/output_tokens, cost, and timestamp for every AI call.

nodes.label: questions Table (with embedding vector(1536))
nodes.rationale: Stores MCQ/true-false/short-answer items; augmented with 1536-dim pgvector embedding column and ivfflat cosine index.

nodes.label: tests Table (with embedding vector(1536))
nodes.rationale: Stores test entities; augmented with 1536-dim pgvector embedding column and ivfflat cosine index for semantic search.

nodes.label: study_materials Table (with embedding vector(1536))
nodes.rationale: Stores learning resources; augmented with 1536-dim pgvector embedding column and ivfflat cosine index.

nodes.label: test_attempts Table
nodes.rationale: Stores user test attempts (created_at, score, user_id) used as source data for churn and engagement prediction.

nodes.label: users Table (referenced by ai_api_usage)
nodes.rationale: User entity referenced via FK by ai_api_usage.user_id; UUID primary key.

nodes.label: Rate Limiting Pattern
nodes.rationale: Two-layer rate limiting: per-user DB check inside handlers (10/hr) plus express-rate-limit middleware (50/hr) keyed by user id.

nodes.label: AI Input Sanitization Pattern
nodes.rationale: validateAIInput strips HTML, caps length at 10000 chars, and blocks prompt-injection patterns before forwarding to LLM.

nodes.label: AI Output Schema Validation Pattern
nodes.rationale: validateAIOutput enforces a schema and checks for harmful content before returning LLM responses to clients.

nodes.label: pgvector Cosine Similarity Search
nodes.rationale: Uses PostgreSQL pgvector extension with ivfflat (lists=100) cosine-ops indexes for fast nearest-neighbor search.

nodes.label: Structured JSON Prompt Pattern
nodes.rationale: All AI features use temperature-controlled prompts with explicit JSON response_format and an expert system role to enforce structured outputs.

nodes.label: Per-Request Cost Tracking Pattern
nodes.rationale: calculateCost multiplies prompt/completion tokens by per-model rates; results persisted in ai_api_usage for ROI and alerting.

nodes.label: AI API Audit Logging
nodes.rationale: Every AI call persists user, model, endpoint, token, and cost rows to ai_api_usage with indexed lookups by user and time.

nodes.label: Human Review Before Save Pattern
nodes.rationale: AI-generated questions are previewed, edited, and bulk-imported by the admin rather than auto-saved.

nodes.label: Decision: OpenRouter Multi-Provider Abstraction
nodes.rationale: Use OpenRouter via the OpenAI SDK so the same code path can route to gpt-4, gpt-3.5-turbo, claude-3-sonnet, whisper-1, and ada-002.

nodes.label: Decision: pgvector over Dedicated Vector DB
nodes.rationale: Store embeddings inside existing Postgres tables via pgvector to avoid a new vector-store service.

nodes.label: Decision: 5-Phase Phased Rollout
nodes.rationale: Sequenced rollout: Foundation (W1-2), Core Features (W3-4), Advanced (W5-7), Polish (W8-9), Experimental (W10-14).

nodes.label: POST /admin/ai/generate-questions
nodes.rationale: Endpoint producing MCQ/T-F/short-answer question arrays; requires topic, difficulty, questionType, count.

nodes.label: POST /admin/ai/suggest-tags
nodes.rationale: Endpoint returning 5-8 suggested tags given content, contentType, and existingTags context.

nodes.label: POST /admin/ai/embed
nodes.rationale: Endpoint returning a 1536-dim embedding vector for arbitrary input text.

nodes.label: GET /admin/ai/search
nodes.rationale: Endpoint performing semantic search over questions, tests, and study_materials; supports type=all|questions|tests|materials.

nodes.label: POST /admin/ai/predict-churn
nodes.rationale: Endpoint computing churn risk from test_attempts using heuristic calculateChurnRisk.

nodes.label: POST /admin/ai/quality-score
nodes.rationale: Endpoint returning a 0-100 quality score and breakdown for content using gpt-4.

nodes.label: POST /admin/ai/generate-faq
nodes.rationale: Endpoint generating FAQ entries from support tickets and existing FAQs using gpt-3.5-turbo.

nodes.label: POST /admin/ai/transcribe-audio
nodes.rationale: Endpoint transcribing audio with whisper-1 and converting to a structured question via gpt-3.5-turbo.

nodes.label: buildQuestionPrompt()
nodes.rationale: Helper composing the JSON-formatted generation prompt with topic, difficulty, type, count, and context.

nodes.label: validateQuestions()
nodes.rationale: Helper trimming and filtering LLM-generated questions to enforce non-empty text, >=2 options, and valid correctAnswer index.

nodes.label: checkRateLimit(userId)
nodes.rationale: Per-user 10-requests-per-hour DB check against ai_api_usage rows in the last hour.

nodes.label: trackAPIUsage({userId,model,tokens,cost})
nodes.rationale: Inserts one row into ai_api_usage capturing user, model, token counts, and cost after each AI call.

nodes.label: calculateCost(usage)
nodes.rationale: Computes total USD cost from prompt/completion token counts using $0.01 and $0.03 per 1K token rates (gpt-4 defaults).

nodes.label: validateAIInput(input)
nodes.rationale: Strips HTML, caps length at 10000 chars, and rejects prompt-injection patterns before sending to the LLM.

nodes.label: validateAIOutput(output, schema)
nodes.rationale: Validates AI response against a schema and runs a harmful-content safety check before returning to the client.

nodes.label: generateEmbeddings() Worker Loop
nodes.rationale: Hourly scheduled loop that selects up to 100 NULL-embedding rows and persists ada-002 embeddings into questions/tests/study_materials.

nodes.label: Env: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
nodes.rationale: Required environment variable holding the OpenRouter API key (sk-or-v1-...).

nodes.label: Env: OPENROUTER_BASE_URL
nodes.rationale: Configurable OpenRouter endpoint, defaults to https://openrouter.ai/api/v1.

nodes.label: Env: AI_RATE_LIMIT_PER_HOUR (50)
nodes.rationale: Configurable per-hour rate-limit ceiling applied by aiRateLimiter middleware.

nodes.label: Env: AI_MAX_TOKENS_PER_REQUEST (4000)
nodes.rationale: Maximum tokens per single LLM request.

nodes.label: Env: AI_COST_ALERT_THRESHOLD (100)
nodes.rationale: Cost alert threshold in USD for the monitoring dashboard.

nodes.label: Env: AI_CACHE_TTL (86400s = 24h)
nodes.rationale: Time-to-live for cached AI responses, satisfying the 24h data retention privacy rule.
